research.title: Robustness of Text Classifiers to Negation and Paraphrase
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare classifier sensitivity to meaning-preserving paraphrases and sentiment-changing negation across review classification datasets.
Implemented controlled perturbations and evaluation routines, separating prediction changes caused by semantic shifts from errors associated with superficial wording differences.

work.title: Document Import Validation and Error Handling
bullets: Implemented validation checks for document import requests, handling missing metadata, malformed text fields, and duplicate submissions within existing service interfaces.
Added regression tests for import failures and revised error messages to distinguish invalid input from temporary processing failures.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Question Matching
bullets: Implemented term-weighted and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval baselines for matching user questions to relevant answers in a fixed document collection.
Compared ranking quality under shared relevance judgments and inspected failures involving rare terminology, ambiguous questions, and overlapping answer content.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented token classification with recurrent and pretrained transformer encoders, aligning subword predictions with annotated entity spans for consistent evaluation.
Compared entity-level precision and recall across label categories, examining boundary errors and inconsistent predictions for entities appearing in unfamiliar contexts.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Ranking
bullets: Implemented frequency-based and graph-based sentence ranking methods for extractive summarization, applying identical preprocessing and summary length constraints across approaches.
Compared reference overlap and manually examined selected summaries for redundancy, missing context, and dependence on sentence position within source documents.
